parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
Consuming-application code (request header). Max 8 characters — ICON sourceofsale limit.
e.g. hybris, avail

schema.ValidateLength: The field Source must be a string with a maximum length of 8.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: Page of results list

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Page size of result list

parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: Account to search

parameters.name: Reference
parameters.description: The customer's order reference to search

parameters.name: Reference2
parameters.description: The customer's secondary order reference to search

parameters.name: MessageCodes
parameters.description: Comma (,) separated list of any current message codes to search by e.g OrderPending,OrderError,OrderProcessing

parameters.name: PreviousMessageCode
parameters.description: Comma (,) separated list of any current message codes to search by e.g OrderPending,OrderError,OrderProcessing

parameters.name: CreationDateFromUtc
parameters.description: Order creation timestamp in Utc. e.g 2025-06-20T15:46:40

parameters.name: UpdateDateFromUtc
parameters.description: Order last update timestamp in Utc. e.g 2025-06-22T10:46:40

parameters.description: created by user to search orders by

parameters.description: contact name to search orders by

ApiRunMode.description: Selects which service implementation handles a request.

GetIconOrderNumberResponse.description: Response model for the get icon order number ACL operation.

GetPubOrderResponse.description: Response model for the get public collect order ACL operation.

GetQuoteResponse.description: Response model for the get quote ACL operation (quote-eapi GET /quote).

GetSendOrdersResponse.description: Response model for the get send orders ACL operation.

HybrisLineStatus.description: Model for the get send orders ACL operation.

calccarriage.description: Calculate carriage (wire: calccarriage). JSON boolean, number, or string.

contractref.description: Contract reference (wire: contractref). Not mapped to CDM / ICON.

price.description: Line price as a number (wire: price).

HybrisSendOrderLines.description: sendorders lines object containing line array.

HybrisSendOrderRequest.description: Hybris POST /sendorders request body (flat header + lines.line shape).

MessageCodes.description: Update message codes for the order

NamedDataCaptureBlock.description:
Named data capture used by pub-order v2 (`datacapture.capture[].key` + `value`).
Reads either `{"capture":[...]}` or a bare array. pub-order-eapi requires the array.

unit.description: Unit of price (may differ from unit of sale).

NestedOrderTally.description: Nested RAML tally row (array on the line, not a wrapper).

OccursDataCaptureBlock.description:
Occurs-style data capture used by nested POST /order and Hybris sendorders
(`datacapture.capture[].occurs` + `value`).

lines.description: Order Lines - each specifying a quantity of a product being ordered
lines.ValidateMinLength: The field Lines must be an array type with a minimum length of 1.
lines.ValidateMaxLength: The field Lines must be an array type with a maximum length of 50.

Order.description: A Sales Order to be placed - or which has been placed

OrderBody.description: Root POST body for order-eapi POST /order and POST /order/refund.

key.description: Name of custom data field captured

value.ValidateLength: The field Value must be a string with a maximum length of 35.

OrderDataCapture.description: Holder of custom data captured to process this order

calcCarriage.description: Calculate carriage charges. JSON boolean, number, or string.

contractReference.description: Contract reference (not mapped to CDM / ICON).

suspendOrderOnCreation.description: Suspend the sales order on creation.

paymentType.description:
Cash type of the payment 

BCGBP = BACS/CHAPS GBP 

DiDe = Direct Debit 

Q = Checque 

A = Credit Card 

C = Cash 

V = Visa Debit 

F = Voucher/Coupon 

x = allocation only 

HCLEG = HX Legacy
paymentType.ValidateLength: The field PaymentType must be a string with a maximum length of 5.

value.ValidateDoubleRange: The field Value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99.

reference.ValidateLength: The field Reference must be a string with a maximum length of 50.

type.description: Cash type on the wire (e.g. CreditCard, OnAccount).

OrderPaymentsBlock.description:
Wire wrapper `payments` used by nested POST /order, Hybris sendorders, and pub-order v2.
Reads either `{"payment":[...]}` or a bare array. pub-order-eapi requires the array.

tallyQuantity.description: number of pieces of this measurement
tallyQuantity.ValidateIntRange: The field TallyQuantity must be between -99999 and 99999.

length.ValidateDoubleRange: The field Length must be between 0.001 and 99999.999.

width.ValidateDoubleRange: The field Width must be between 0.001 and 99999.999.

OrderTally.description: a cut of some material to be supplied

PostPubOrderResponse.description: Response model for the post public collect order ACL operation (200 + body).

number.description: ICON order number when assigned; null while pending.

PublicCollectOrder.description:
Public collect order envelope used by pub-order-eapi POST and GET /order.
Wire names are `account` / `branch` (not `accountCode` / `branchCode`).

lines.description: Order lines (minItems 1, maxItems 50 on normative OpenAPI).

PublicCollectTally.description: One tally row on a public collect line.

QuoteBody.description: Root POST body for quote-eapi POST /quote.

QuoteSummary.description: One quote row (QuoteSummary in Planned OpenAPI).

source.description:
Consuming-application code (request header). Max 8 characters — ICON sourceofsale limit.
e.g. hybris, avail
source.ValidateLength: The field Source must be a string with a maximum length of 8.

account.description: Account to create the sales order against
account.ValidateFormat: The field Account must match the regular expression '^[A-Z0-9]{7,8}$'.

branch.description: Branch to create the sales order at
branch.ValidateIntRange: The field Branch must be between 1 and 9999.

createUser.description: User to create the sales order
createUser.ValidateLength: The field CreateUser must be a string with a maximum length of 20.

reference.description: The customer's order reference - must be unique per source and account
reference.ValidateLength: The field Reference must be a string with a maximum length of 20.
reference.ValidateFormat: The field Reference must match the regular expression '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9\/\-_ \.]{1,19}$'.

reference2.ValidateLength: The field Reference2 must be a string with a maximum length of 20.

requiredByDate.description: Date of the sales order is required by

requestedDate.description: Customer requested date, defaults to date requried if not specified

deliveryRecipientName.ValidateLength: The field DeliveryRecipientName must be a string with a maximum length of 45.

deliveryAddressLine.description: First Address line for the delivery address
deliveryAddressLine.ValidateLength: The field DeliveryAddressLine must be a string with a maximum length of 35.

deliveryAddressStreet.description: Second Address line for the delivery address
deliveryAddressStreet.ValidateLength: The field DeliveryAddressStreet must be a string with a maximum length of 35.

deliveryCity.description: Third Address line for the delivery address
deliveryCity.ValidateLength: The field DeliveryCity must be a string with a maximum length of 35.

deliveryPostCode.description: Postal code for the delivery address
deliveryPostCode.ValidateLength: The field DeliveryPostCode must be a string with a maximum length of 9.

deliveryCountry.description: Country 2 letter Iso code for the delivery address
deliveryCountry.ValidateLength: The field DeliveryCountry must be a string with a maximum length of 2.

invoiceRecipientName.ValidateLength: The field InvoiceRecipientName must be a string with a maximum length of 45.

invoiceAddressLine.description: First Address line for the invoice recipient
invoiceAddressLine.ValidateLength: The field InvoiceAddressLine must be a string with a maximum length of 35.

invoiceAddressStreet.description: Second Address line for the invoice recipient
invoiceAddressStreet.ValidateLength: The field InvoiceAddressStreet must be a string with a maximum length of 35.

invoiceAddressCity.description: Third Address line for the invoice recipient
invoiceAddressCity.ValidateLength: The field InvoiceAddressCity must be a string with a maximum length of 35.

invoicePostCode.description: Postal code for the invoice recipient
invoicePostCode.ValidateLength: The field InvoicePostCode must be a string with a maximum length of 9.

invoiceCountry.description: Country 2 letter Iso code for the invoice recipient
invoiceCountry.ValidateLength: The field InvoiceCountry must be a string with a maximum length of 2.

instructions.description: External text to appear on the order's header for invoicing
instructions.ValidateMultiLine: The multi-line field Instructions must be a string with a maximum length of 990 with length of each line not exceeding 97.

deliveryInstructions.description: Internal text to appear on the header for delivery

carrierSerForOrder.description: Carrier service to be used on the sales order
carrierSerForOrder.ValidateLength: The field CarrierSerForOrder must be a string with a maximum length of 8.

carrierSerLevForOrder.description: Carrier service level to be used on the sales order
carrierSerLevForOrder.ValidateLength: The field CarrierSerLevForOrder must be a string with a maximum length of 8.

calcCarrierCharges.description: flag to ask for calculation of carriage charges

suspendOrder.description: Suspend the sales order upon creation

suspendUser.description: User ID to suspend the sales order against
suspendUser.ValidateLength: The field SuspendUser must be a string with a maximum length of 20.

suspendMessage.description: Message to suspend the sales order
suspendMessage.ValidateLength: The field SuspendMessage must be a string with a maximum length of 256.

deliveryMethod.description:
Delivery method for the sales order  

D is Delivery and applies when OrderCategory is Delivery  

L means collect later and applies when order category is C for collection
deliveryMethod.ValidateLength: The field DeliveryMethod must be a string with a maximum length of 1.

sourceOfSale.description: ICON source of sale (`sourceofsale`). Max 8 characters.
sourceOfSale.ValidateLength: The field SourceOfSale must be a string with a maximum length of 8.

externalUser.description: User ID for the external user
externalUser.ValidateLength: The field ExternalUser must be a string with a maximum length of 20.

externalSystem.ValidateLength: The field ExternalSystem must be a string with a maximum length of 10.

externalOrderRef.description: Reference number relevant to the external system
externalOrderRef.ValidateLength: The field ExternalOrderRef must be a string with a maximum length of 35.

contactName.ValidateLength: The field ContactName must be a string with a maximum length of 100.

contactEmail.ValidateLength: The field ContactEmail must be a string with a maximum length of 100.

contactPhone.ValidateLength: The field ContactPhone must be a string with a maximum length of 30.

contactMobile.ValidateLength: The field ContactMobile must be a string with a maximum length of 30.

siteContactName.description: Site contact name, overrides the site contact number
siteContactName.ValidateLength: The field SiteContactName must be a string with a maximum length of 100.

siteContactId.ValidateUIntRange: The field SiteContactId must be between 1 and 4294967295.

siteTelephone.ValidateLength: The field SiteTelephone must be a string with a maximum length of 30.

siteMobile.ValidateLength: The field SiteMobile must be a string with a maximum length of 30.

adviceMethod.description:
Advice method for the sales order 

Determines how Prices are displayed in advice notes 

L - List price 

P - Priced 

U - Unpriced
adviceMethod.ValidateLength: The field AdviceMethod must be a string with a maximum length of 1.

acknowledgePrice.description:
Acknowledgement prices for the sales order  

Describes how prices are displayed on acknowledgements 

P = Priced 

U = Unpriced 

L = List price 

E = Electronic priced only
acknowledgePrice.ValidateLength: The field AcknowledgePrice must be a string with a maximum length of 1.

isWebOrder.description: Sales order is a web order

supplyStatus.description:
Supply status for the sales order 

Could be  

C - Complete - all orderlines must be completed 

P - Partial supply - some orderlines can be supplied 

M - Manual - partial order supply is allowed but up to User 

U - User when complete - supply only after User changes Supply status to another value
supplyStatus.ValidateLength: The field SupplyStatus must be a string with a maximum length of 1.

supplyEmail.description: Supplier email address to use for direct orders
supplyEmail.ValidateLength: The field SupplyEmail must be a string with a maximum length of 100.

payments.description: Payment infomation related to this order

datacapture.description: Custom specific data needed for this customer, may include may things like vehicle registration, job number etc.
datacapture.ValidateMaxLength: The field Datacapture must be an array type with a maximum length of 14.
datacapture.ValidateDataCaptureEntry: The entry jobNumber in field Datacapture must be a string with a maximum length of 20.

messageDesc.description:
Updated Message Code Description 

(Read only cannnot be set through the api)

number.description:
Order Number a unique number assigned for this order when placed 

(Read only cannnot be set through the api)

pendingRetriesCount.description:
A count of tries to place the order which have had recoverable errors (e.g. timeouts)  

(Read only cannnot be set through the api)

processingRetriesCount.description:
A count of consecutive tries to get updates for the order which have had recoverable errors (e.g. timeouts)  

(Read only cannnot be set through the api)

V1OrderHeader.description: Contains information common to all Order Lines

productCode.ValidateFormat: The field ProductCode must match the regular expression '[A-Z0-9]{8}$'.

manufacturer.ValidateLength: The field Manufacturer must be a string with a maximum length of 8.

quantity.description: the quantity of the product to be supplied in terms of the unit of sale
quantity.ValidateDoubleRange: The field Quantity must be between -999999999.9999 and 999999999.9999.

unitOfSale.description: the unit of sale of the quantity
unitOfSale.ValidateLength: The field UnitOfSale must be a string with a maximum length of 2.

requiredByDate.description: supply is required by this date

instructions.description: special instructions for this order line
instructions.ValidateMultiLine: The multi-line field Instructions must be a string with a maximum length of 990 with length of each line not exceeding 97.

sellingPrice.description:
The price of this order line
(leave empty to apply default pricing)
sellingPrice.ValidateDoubleRange: The field SellingPrice must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99.

unitPrice.ValidateLength: The field UnitPrice must be a string with a maximum length of 2.

supplier.ValidateLength: The field Supplier must be a string with a maximum length of 8.

tally.description: cuts needed to the order line

statusCode.description:
the status code for this order 

ADI	Pre-Invoice 

ADV Waiting advice note 

ALS Original for Alternative 

ALT Alternate {Product} 

ASC Associated { Product } 

BRK Break order line 

COM Completed line 

CRC Converted to Credit 

CRS In-Line Return Stock Credit 

CRT Converted to Credit(In-Line) 

CRV In-Line Value Only Credit 

CUS Call customer back 

DEL Deleted line 

EST Estimates 

GEN Generate schedule 

GRP Line Group Header 

HAL Alternate Haulier(Directs) 

HLD Stock Reservation 

IBT Inter-branch transfer 

IBX IBT exception 

KIT Process kit list 

LOP Lost sale(Price) 

LOS Lost sale(Stock) 

LOV Lost sale(Value) 

MEM Memo line 

NDX Operation Not Complete 

OFF Call off later(Directs) 

PIK Pick note printed 

PIQ Batch pick awaiting print 

PRO Process document 

PUR Purchase order 

REC Goods received 

RGD Regrade product 

RTS { Return to supplier } 

SBO Stock backorder 

TFR Transfer to Branch 

UTS Unable to Supply 

VOR Emergency Purchase 

WDL Waiting delivery 

WDX Operation Complete 

WOS Work outstanding 

WRK Create works order 

WXO External work to be done 

WXS External work at supplier 

XCL Cancelled by Customer

statusDesc.description: description of the status or this order line

V1OrderLine.description: Part of an order that specifies a product and quantity to be supplied

Bearer.description: Server consumer JWT. Enter the token only — do NOT prefix with 'Bearer '.

XSessionId.description: User consumer Okta session id validated via the session validator API.
XSessionId.name: X-Session-Id
